summary: Validate Sentinel KQL and Splunk SPL detection rules against labeled positive, negative, and boundary telemetry fixtures.
limitations: Operates offline with a deterministic reference evaluator; does not prove actual live Kusto or Splunk indexer scheduling and alert firing.
Precision and recall metrics are measured strictly on labeled test fixtures and must not be cited as production efficacy rates.
Detection fixtures model event streams and boundary conditions; live pipeline ingest latencies require dedicated telemetry proof packs.

demo.description: Run offline quality evaluation of Microsoft Sentinel KQL and Splunk SPL rules against positive, negative, and schema-drift fixtures.
